hard_boundaries: Edit only pipeline/project: implementation bodies in src/main/** and own tests in tests/**.
Never modify the Java source; never change a signature, class name, method name, field name, type annotation or module path in src/main/**.
Never search/read/create/modify anything under src/test/** (held-out oracle path); it must not exist in the working copy.
Keep the tree importable at all times (no syntax error / missing module).

conventions.package_mapping: org.apache.commons.cli -> src.main.org.apache.commons.cli (one Java class -> one same-stem Python module).
conventions.overloads: Disambiguated with numeric suffixes exactly as in the skeleton (already matched in the decomposed Java source). Do NOT merge or renumber.
conventions.constructors: Overloaded constructors -> single __init__(self, constructorId, ...) dispatching on constructorId, plus suffixed @staticmethod factories (Option1/Option2, UnrecognizedOptionException1, AlreadySelectedException0/1, MissingArgumentException1, MissingOptionException1). DefaultParser.__init__ dispatches on constructorId 0/1/else.
conventions.char_to_str: Java char params/fields -> 1-char str; char-overloads delegate to their String twin (String.valueOf(c) is identity). char default '\u0000' -> chr(0); 'valuesep > 0' -> ord(self.__valuesep) > 0.
conventions.nulls_boxed: null -> None; boxed scalars -> plain int/float/bool; String[] -> list[str]; Class<?> -> a Python type/sentinel; Util.EMPTY_STRING_ARRAY -> [].
conventions.statics: static members -> class attributes (Option.UNINITIALIZED=-1/UNLIMITED_VALUES=-2; HelpFormatter.DEFAULT_*; PatternOptionBuilder.*_VALUE; OptionBuilder static state; __serialVersionUID retained, value irrelevant).
conventions.visibility: protected -> single leading underscore; private -> double leading underscore (name-mangled), matching the skeleton exactly.
conventions.dunders: Keep skeleton equals/hashCode/toString AND mirror with __eq__/__hash__/__str__ where the Java type flows through equality/hash/string contexts.
conventions.import_cycle: Benign OptionGroup<->AlreadySelectedException cycle: safe only because `from __future__ import annotations` defers annotations and each references the other ONLY inside method bodies. Keep it that way.

exception_mapping.ParseException(+5 subtypes): same names/hierarchy (skeleton); subclass Exception; messages verbatim
exception_mapping.RuntimeException: RuntimeError (Option.__add/addValueForProcessing/clone; catch sites `except RuntimeError` in Parser.processArgs, *.handleProperties)
exception_mapping.CloneNotSupportedException: no analogue; keep try/except shell as a dead branch to mirror structure

external_seams.output_sink: HelpFormatter writes through injected pw (io.StringIO/sys.stdout). System.out overloads (printHelp0/1/4/5/6/7) construct a writer over sys.stdout; pw overloads use the caller's stream. pw.println(s) -> pw.write(s + newline); newline == getNewLine() (os.linesep). Use io.StringIO for StringBuffer params (_renderOptions/_renderWrappedText/__appendOption(Group)); local buffers may be str.
external_seams.filesystem_url_class: TypeHandler: createFile -> pathlib.Path(str_); openFile -> open(str_,'rb') (missing -> ParseException); createURL -> urllib.parse.urlparse scheme validation + geturl() round-trip (malformed -> ParseException); createClass/createObject -> resolve dotted name via importlib/pydoc.locate (unresolved -> ParseException), instantiate for OBJECT_VALUE (failure -> ParseException).
external_seams.properties: accept a plain mapping (dict); iterate keys, .get(name); None -> no-op early return (processProperties/handleProperties).

translation_rules.stdlib_counterparts: list/dict/set for Java collections; functools.cmp_to_key over the Callable comparator; io.StringIO for StringBuilder/PrintWriter; pathlib.Path for File; urllib.parse for URL; datetime/numbers sentinels; importlib/pydoc.locate for Class.forName. Prefer stdlib; add no third-party deps. Only genuinely new utility: a stdlib name->class resolver for TypeHandler.

Each module mirrors a source JUnit test class (analysis §1.7/§3.6). mode: translate-directly (state-based source analogue) or needs-new-test (Python-idiom / composed, no 1:1 source file).
seams: output_sink: HelpFormatter pw parameter -> io.StringIO test double (tests/conftest.py::sink).
filesystem: TypeHandler.openFile/createFile -> tmp_path real file (conftest::existing_file) + guaranteed-absent path (conftest::absent_path).
url: TypeHandler.createURL -> real well-formed vs malformed strings (no network).
